status: CRL-2a development contract; source-blocked; target blind

edge.input: primitive pre-event packet and typed closure/transport state plus pre-known event descriptor
edge.target: source-authenticated post-event hard factors and mask
edge.forbidden_input: post-event receipts, factors, mask, outcome-derived event subtype

pair.input: pre-event pair state plus source-authenticated sink descriptor available before gate response (possibly after event)
pair.target: independently read post-event pair gate q_next
pair.forbidden_input: post-event gate response or label inferred from it
pair.timing_scope: conditional response only unless a separate pre-event sink-occurrence law is supplied

candidate_freeze_requires: source section, version and hash for each primitive update
state space, domain, codomain, factor conventions and event order
complete code and precommitted output for each source-authenticated held-out event
S4 relabeling covariance and null/reduction behavior
declared pair-to-edge map if any joint claim is attempted
exclusions, missing-data handling, baseline outputs and interpretation rules before target exposure

outcomes.SOURCE_BLOCKED: No source-complete candidate before target exposure
outcomes.FAIL: One mismatch in a claimed universal deterministic rule within its frozen domain
outcomes.INCONCLUSIVE: No discriminating edge switch or intact-sink readout for the corresponding branch
outcomes.SCOPED_PASS: All frozen in-domain predictions exact, including at least one discriminating event; baselines reported; constructor-only until independent review
outcomes.EXPLORATORY: Candidate or exclusions changed after target exposure

physical_bridge: NONE; event index has no calibrated time unit
